title: cassia fasciculata var. depressa
intro: Cassia fasciculata var. depressa, commonly known as Sensitive Plant or Sensitive Weed, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. It is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cassia fasciculata var. depressa include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
